recipeScope: Use exact recorded source/app/library identities and pinned Local services in a separate owned private run.
Use installed agent Chrome/private profile and genuine UI interactions; no mocks, route interception, DOM/application-state injection or source changes.
Select Neutral and Light+ in the real Settings UI; use rendered colors and resolved CSS for comparison.
Exercise the frozen named states, capture original native action timing and stills, and read only the named role properties.
Keep model configuration unused/unconfigured, make no connection/auth submission or conversation/automation execution, then stop/purge only owned runtime state and probe its actual owned ports.

media.encode: Each scene has an independent decoder before a single continuous H264 limited yuv420p encode; AAC, faststart, no stream-copy concatenation.
media.ambience: Original synthesized quiet pad; mean approximately -52.5 dBFS, not application audio.
media.seekValidation: Every scene first/middle/last independently sought and compared against one continuous decode.

limits: Genuine live UI evidence is standalone Local Canvas; live Cloud, ACP, authentication, provider, arbitrary nested embedded host, and model behavior are not claimed.
No model credential configured or model invoked; no connection/authentication UI submission, conversation creation or automation execution.
Only frozen named states and selected computed roles are compared. Native timings are independent; no whole-page pixel or synchronized-frame identity claim.
Original PNG/MP4 bytes and pixels remain unchanged. Visible owned loopback ports can differ across phases and are benign context.
Light+/Neutral are established by actual UI selection, rendered colors and resolved CSS. Legacy data-theme metadata is null and does not identify the selected theme.
Exact built CSS and isolated compiler/fixture proof is separate from live host/user-flow behavior.
CLI native recordings retain their existing cadence, trimmed still lead-in/final hold, and exact canonical recorder statistics. No motion interpolation or editorial speed change.
Settings navigation can show only the automation secret name, never its value. Existing narrow menu truncation/layout is preserved; no readability or overflow improvement is claimed.
